segments.motivation: To coordinate complex projects, track progress across teams, manage resources, and ensure strategic alignment of work.
To organize specific campaigns, standardize workflows, automate routine tasks, and ensure clear communication within functional teams.
To gain a holistic view of organizational goals, leverage AI for workflow optimization, and ensure consistent context across human and AI-driven work.

tasks.purpose: with clear owners and due dates
using different visual layouts like Kanban or Gantt charts

tasks.context: on project status and team workload

benefits.claim: The product provides a centralized, shared view of all project components, progress, and deadlines, reducing information silos.
It automates routine processes and standardizes work requests, leading to greater operational efficiency.
The product facilitates seamless collaboration among human teams and AI agents by providing shared context and a single plan.

frictions.claim: The extensive feature set and customization options can lead to a steep learning curve or feel overwhelming for new users.
Some valuable features or increased user capacity may be locked behind higher-tier subscription plans.
Users might face difficulties in effectively training, guiding, or fully integrating AI teammates into existing complex workflows.

unknowns: Specific performance issues (e.g., speed, responsiveness) of the application.
The practical effectiveness and ease of use of AI Teammates in day-to-day scenarios.
The quality and responsiveness of customer support for advanced features or issues.
